command:
set -eo pipefail
source /workspace/env.sh
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /workspace/hyper-parallel
test_venv=/work/venvs/cpu-device-index-tests
if [[ ! -e "$test_venv/bin/python" ]]; then
 python -m venv --system-site-packages "$test_venv"
 printf '%s\n' /workspace/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages > "$test_venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/workspace-base.pth"
fi
export PATH="$test_venv/bin:$PATH"
python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=/work/tmp/issue211-test-wheels pytest==9.1.1
python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation --use-pep517 -e .
python -c 'import hyper_parallel; print(hyper_parallel.__file__); assert hyper_parallel.__file__.startswith("/workspace/hyper-parallel/")'
python -m pytest -q tests/ut/auto_models/test_build_options.py tests/ut/models/jt_deepseek_v3/test_jt_builder.py
python /work/tools/cpu_device_index_probe.py
